# Bariatric Surgery Authorization Guide

## CPT Codes — Bariatric Surgery

| CPT | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 43775 | Laparoscopic sleeve gastrectomy, including gastroesophageal reflux disease evaluation | Sleeve gastrectomy — most commonly performed bariatric procedure |
| 43644 | Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass; with small intestine reconstruction to bypass stomach, duodenum, and all or part of jejunum | RYGB — gold standard for T2DM remission |
| 43645 | Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass; with small intestine reconstruction to bypass stomach, duodenum, and all or part of jejunum; with gastric pouch creation | RYGB with pouch creation |
| 43770 | Laparoscopic, gastric restrictive procedure; placement of adjustable gastric band (gastric band and subcutaneous port components) | Adjustable gastric band — less commonly performed |
| 43843 | Gastric restrictive procedure, without gastric bypass, for morbid obesity; other than vertical-banded gastroplasty | Open sleeve or restrictive procedure |
| 43846 | Gastric restrictive procedure, with gastric bypass for morbid obesity; with short limb (150 cm or less) Roux-en-Y gastroenterostomy | Open RYGB |
| 43659 | Unlisted laparoscopic procedure, stomach | Revision/conversion procedures — requires documentation |

## ICD-10 Codes

| ICD-10 | Description | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| E66.01 | Morbid (severe) obesity due to excess calories | BMI ≥40 — primary code for Class III obesity |
| E66.09 | Other obesity due to excess calories | BMI 35–39.9 — Class II obesity |
| E66.9 | Obesity, unspecified | Use specific code when possible |
| Z68.41 | Body mass index (BMI) 40.0-44.9, adult | BMI specificity code — use with E66.01 |
| Z68.42 | Body mass index (BMI) 45.0-49.9, adult | BMI specificity code |
| Z68.43 | Body mass index (BMI) 50.0-59.9, adult | BMI specificity code |
| E11.9 | Type 2 diabetes mellitus without complications | T2DM — key comorbidity for metabolic surgery indication |
| I10 | Essential (primary) hypertension | Hypertension comorbidity |
| G47.33 | Obstructive sleep apnea (adult) | OSA comorbidity |

## Payer Requirements

Tabs: Medicare | Medicaid | Private

### Medicare

**Required Documentation**
- BMI ≥35 with at least one obesity-related comorbidity (T2DM, HTN, OSA, dyslipidemia, GERD, osteoarthritis, etc.)
- Documentation of failure of non-surgical weight loss treatment
- Psychological evaluation confirming no active contraindications
- Nutrition consultation completed
- Surgery performed at a Bariatric Surgery Center of Excellence (BSCOE) or similar accredited facility
- Surgeon must have specific bariatric surgery training and experience
- Multidisciplinary team evaluation (surgery, nutrition, psychology, medicine)

**Medical Necessity Criteria**
- ✓ BMI ≥35 with obesity-related comorbidity OR BMI ≥40 without comorbidity
- ✓ Failed non-surgical weight loss attempts
- ✓ Psychological clearance
- ✓ Nutrition consultation

**Reimbursement Note:** Medicare covers bariatric surgery for BMI ≥35 with at least one obesity-related comorbidity when performed at an accredited facility. Coverage includes sleeve gastrectomy (43775), RYGB (43644), and adjustable gastric band (43770). Note: Medicare does NOT cover bariatric surgery for BMI 30–34.9 even with T2DM, unlike the 2022 ASMBS guidelines.

**Known Payer Policies**
- [Covered] Medicare (CMS): Covered for BMI ≥35 + comorbidity at accredited BSCOE; sleeve, RYGB, and band covered

### Medicaid

**Required Documentation**
- State-specific criteria — most states follow Medicare BMI ≥35 + comorbidity criteria
- Supervised weight loss program (3–6 months depending on state)
- Psychological evaluation
- Nutrition consultation
- Prior authorization required

**Medical Necessity Criteria**
- ✓ BMI ≥35 with comorbidity (most states) or BMI ≥40
- ✓ Completed supervised weight loss program
- ✓ Psychological clearance

**Reimbursement Note:** Medicaid coverage varies significantly by state. Most states cover bariatric surgery for BMI ≥35 with comorbidities. Some states require 6-month supervised program. A few states do not cover bariatric surgery at all. Verify state-specific policy.

**Known Payer Policies**
- [Covered] Medicaid (state-specific): Coverage varies; most states require BMI ≥35 + comorbidity + supervised program; verify state policy

### Private

**Required Documentation**
- Prior authorization required by all commercial payers
- BMI ≥40 OR BMI ≥35 with at least one obesity-related comorbidity
- Documented failure of supervised weight loss program (typically 6 months — diet, exercise, behavioral modification)
- Psychological evaluation and clearance
- Nutrition consultation
- Medical clearance from primary care physician
- Multidisciplinary team evaluation
- Accredited bariatric surgery facility (MBSAQIP or equivalent)

**Medical Necessity Criteria**
- ✓ BMI ≥40 (Class III obesity) — primary criterion
- ✓ BMI ≥35 with documented comorbidity (T2DM, HTN, OSA, GERD, dyslipidemia, osteoarthritis, etc.)
- ✓ BMI ≥30 with T2DM or metabolic syndrome — some plans per 2022 ASMBS guidelines
- ✓ Failed ≥6 months of supervised, physician-directed weight loss program
- ✓ Psychological clearance with no active contraindications

**Reimbursement Note:** Commercial payers almost universally require a 6-month supervised weight loss program. Document each monthly visit with weight, dietary counseling, and exercise guidance. Some plans require the program to be supervised by a physician (not just a dietitian). Psychological clearance must specifically address bariatric surgery. Accredited facility (MBSAQIP) is required by most payers.

**Known Payer Policies**
- [Covered] UnitedHealthcare: Covers BMI ≥40 or ≥35 + comorbidity; 6-month supervised program required; MBSAQIP facility required
- [Covered] Aetna: Covers BMI ≥40 or ≥35 + comorbidity; 6-month program; psychological clearance required
- [Covered] Cigna: Covers BMI ≥40 or ≥35 + comorbidity; 6-month program; accredited facility required
- [Covered] Anthem/BCBS: Covers BMI ≥40 or ≥35 + comorbidity; 6-month program; multidisciplinary team evaluation required
- [Covered] Humana: Covers BMI ≥40 or ≥35 + comorbidity; 6-month program; psychological and nutrition clearance required
